name: Rize India Payroll Client Master 2026

rules.name: Employee Code
rules.note: Canonical employee-master ID; historical payroll code is retained separately. Identity conflicts must be approved before import.

rules.name: Employee ID
rules.note: Global ID from the India employee master. Initially the same canonical ID as Employee Code; both native identity fields are kept consistent.

rules.name: DOR
rules.note: Last employment date reported by payroll. A source/master status conflict requires review; historical pay must remain possible.

rules.name: No. of Working Days
rules.note: Salary I11 calendar-day divisor. Enter the applicable month divisor, including the full-month denominator for a leaver.

rules.name: No. of days paid
rules.note: Salary I: actual payable days. The client leaver has 14/31 days.

rules.name: Arrears Days
rules.note: Source reference quantity. The client workbook does not turn it into pay. Approved arrears payment is a separate monthly amount.

rules.name: Annual Fixed CTC
rules.note: Annual fixed CTC includes employer PF. Kept as one relational contract amount. August payroll is authoritative for pay amounts.

rules.name: Variable Component
rules.note: Annual target variable component, information only. It is not automatically paid every month.

rules.name: Annual CTC
rules.note: Calculated from the August client payroll. Never an Excel or employee-record mapping input.

rules.name: Basic rounding adjustment
rules.note: Explicit signed adjustment found in the client row formula (+1 or -1 rupee). Included inside the corresponding earning once. Zero in a normal month unless the payroll owner approves an adjustment.

rules.name: PF contribution basis

rules.name: Payroll input validation
rules.formula: IF(OR({INANNFIX}<=0,{INWDAYS}<=0,{INPDAYS}<0,{INPDAYS}>{INWDAYS},{INLEAVEDAYS}<0),"Review salary or days",IF(AND({INPFMODE}<>"Capped",{INPFMODE}<>"Full basic"),"Review PF contribution basis",IF(AND({INADAYS}<>0,{INARREARS}=0),"Review arrears payment","Ready")))
rules.note: Calculated from the August client payroll. Never an Excel or employee-record mapping input.

source_notes: Salary TDS, professional tax and employee PF are approved monthly inputs: no source calculation is supplied.
Annual target variable pay is information only; the payout is a separate monthly input.
Basic/HRA row-level rounding corrections are visible signed monthly adjustments.
Historical PF constants reproduce August and must be reviewed for later-period statutory changes.
